title: Document Cortex
heading: Upload a document. Get a compliance read.
subheading: Upload a spec, label, or test report and see the product it describes, the standards that apply, and what's missing before certification.
demoNotice: Demo analysis — illustrates the result format using a sample outcome, not a real parse of this file's contents.
demoHint: Tip: a filename containing "helmet", "cooker", "appliance", or "toy" shows a matching demo scenario.

sections.issuesEmpty: No issues flagged in this demo scenario.

chinStrap.title: Chin strap retention test missing
chinStrap.description: IS 4151 requires a documented dynamic retention test report for the chin strap assembly — not present in this document.

peripheralVision.title: Peripheral vision field unspecified
peripheralVision.description: The document doesn't state the peripheral vision field angle required under IS 4151 §5.3.

recommendations.attachChinStrapReport: Attach a third-party lab report for chin-strap retention testing.
recommendations.addLicenceNumber: Include the BIS licence number on the document's cover page.

valveRating.title: Safety valve rating not cross-referenced
valveRating.description: The stated safety-valve pressure rating isn't matched against the IS 2347 Table 3 limits for this cooker size.

recommendations.referenceValveTable: Cross-reference the safety-valve pressure rating against IS 2347 Table 3.
recommendations.attachHydrostaticCert: Attach the hydrostatic test certificate for this batch.

earthContinuity.title: Earth continuity test not documented
earthContinuity.description: IS 302 requires a passed earth-continuity test report — none is referenced in this document.

insulationLabel.title: Insulation class not labelled
insulationLabel.description: The document doesn't state the appliance's insulation class (Class I/II) required for the safety marking.

recommendations.retestEarthContinuity: Commission an earth-continuity test and attach the report.
recommendations.clarifyInsulationClass: State the insulation class (Class I or II) explicitly in the document.

smallParts.title: Small-parts choke test not documented
smallParts.description: IS 9873 (Part 1) requires a small-parts cylinder test for products intended for children under 3 — not present here.

recommendations.addChokeWarning: Add the required choke-hazard warning label text to the packaging artwork.
recommendations.resubmitSmallPartsTest: Resubmit with a small-parts cylinder test report from an accredited lab.
